description_en: Updates the remarks for an address in Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0
description_zh: 通过地址的 ID修改地址备注信息
name: UpdateCloudGtmAddressRemark

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese

en-US (default): English
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

zh-CN：中文

en-US（默认）：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique across requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters long
parameters.help_zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。注意  由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the address
parameters.help_zh: 地址的ID，地址唯一标识码
parameters.name: address_id

parameters.help_en: The new remarks for the address. To delete the remarks, leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh: 传入的参数作为更新后的备注，传空值则删除备注
parameters.name: remark

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful.

true: The operation was successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
本次修改操作是否成功：

true：操作成功

false：操作失败
